concept.biography: A spiral of crimson, lavender and ochre pigment, animated by currents rather than joints. It borrows a pair of needle-bearing painted hands to reach beyond its own canvas.
concept.counterplay: Jump Wet Binding. Punish Impasto recovery. During Borrowed Hands the core cannot move or guard; strike either core or hands to dismiss the summon.
concept.artStatus: BFL reference paintings; Pruna video-derived motion. Separate controllable hands actor.

comboRoutes.name: Wet into wet
comboRoutes.purpose: A light confirm flows through a low sweep into heavy pushback.

moves.description: Down + light: a rising paint crescent catches aerial approaches.
Down + heavy: spend 30 pigment to control floating needle-hands for four seconds. Body remains vulnerable; a hit dismisses them.
Light + medium: an extending paint loop catches and reels in grounded opponents. Jump to evade.
A thin pigment ribbon snaps forward. Confirm into Undertow or Impasto.
A low paint ribbon sweeps beneath standing guard.
Heavy: the entire spiral uncoils into a forceful wave.
Hands light: a precise needle thrust.
Hands medium: opposing palms close around the torso, lift and swing the opponent, then throw.
Hands heavy: dismiss early and regain body control.
